concepts.description: A synthetic instruction to arrange shipping for a scenario order. Main examples reuse Northwind identifiers; additional synthetic control orders need not exist in Northwind. Publication and receipt do not prove a carrier assignment, shipment or delivery.
One numbered processing attempt for a shipping request using a pinned routing configuration. The baseline contains accepted and blocked attempts; future replay examples are stored separately.
A synthetic routing destination identified by partner_id, with an enabled flag. It represents the training fixture's partner configuration, not evidence of a real carrier call.
A synthetic acceptance of an attempt by a carrier partner, protected by a deduplication key. Assignment acceptance does not establish physical dispatch or delivery.
An immutable numbered configuration revision used when an attempt starts and by the routes published for that revision.
A time-bounded mapping from a shipper identifier to a partner within one routing configuration. Overlapping or expired routes are retained for diagnostic examples.
Acknowledgement that a request message was published. Publication acknowledgement alone does not prove receipt, carrier acceptance, or delivery.
Observation that a request message was received by the synthetic shipping process. Receipt alone does not prove successful routing or a carrier assignment.
An indexed observation within a shipping attempt, with a sequence, clock domain, timestamp precision and a byte-range pointer to its immutable source log artifact.
The synthetic fixture generation, active configuration and business clock used to evaluate current routes. The business clock is scenario state, not the current wall clock.

The scenario order identifier to which the request belongs. Orders 11038, 11045 and 11062 reuse Northwind order identifiers; 90001–90005 are synthetic controls that need not resolve to Northwind rows. This is a declared semantic reference, not a SQLite foreign key or automatic join.
The recorded processing state of an attempt. A blocked attempt is not an accepted carrier assignment; the state describes only this synthetic processing attempt.
The same request message identifier carried through request creation, publication and receipt. Sharing it correlates observations; it does not establish completion.
A scenario correlation identifier used to relate shipping requests to synthetic carrier-gateway log entries.
The recorded event timestamp, interpreted with clock_domain and precision_ms. Time values from different clock domains must not be assumed directly comparable.
The clock domain in which an event timestamp was recorded; precision_ms declares its resolution.
